question: From the top of a building 72.1 { m} high, the angle of depression to a car on the ground is 45^circ . Find the distance of the car from the foot of the building.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In a right triangle, if the angle of depression is 45°, then base = height (since tan 45° = 1).

Here, height = 72.1 m, so distance of the car from the foot = height.

**∴ Answer = 72.1 m**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Height of building = 72.1 m

Angle of depression = 45°

**Formula used:**

tan θ = opposite ÷ adjacent

 
• 
• 
• 72.1 m Distance θ = 45° 

**Calculations:**

tan 45° = 72.1 ÷ distance

⇒ tan 45° = 1 ⇒ distance = 72.1 m

**∴ The correct answer is 72.1 m.**
